title: 2022 AMC 8 Problem 11
statement: Henry the donkey has a very long piece of pasta. He takes a number of bites of pasta, each time eating \(3\) inches of pasta from the middle of one piece. In the end, he has \(10\) pieces of pasta whose total length is \(17\) inches. How long, in inches, was the piece of pasta he started with?

solutions.text:
Since there are \(10\) pieces, there were \(9\) locations where a bite was made. Since we have \(9\) bites and \(3\) inches are removed per bite, a total of \(27\) inches were removed.

With \(27\) inches removed and \(17\) inches remaining, we know we started with \(27+17 = 44 \) inches.

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Each bite increases the number of pasta pieces by \(1\)
To end with \(10\) pieces, Henry made \(9\) bites
